The `SSLHandshakeException: Trust anchor for certification path not found` error occurred because the debug build connects to the local development API over HTTPS (`https://10.0.2.2:8443/`) using a self-signed development CA certificate (`dev-ca/shelftap-dev-ca.pem`), which Android does not trust by default.

### Changes Made

1. **Added CA Certificate to Raw Resources**:
   - Copied the development CA certificate to [shelftap_dev_ca.pem](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r4/work/app/src/main/res/raw/shelftap_dev_ca.pem).

2. **Created Network Security Config**:
   - Created [network_security_config.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r4/work/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml) with `<debug-overrides>` trusting `@raw/shelftap_dev_ca` and user-installed certificates for debug builds while keeping release builds restricted to system trust anchors.

3. **Configured Application Manifest**:
   - Updated [AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r4/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L6-L10) to declare `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"`.
